verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own API docs include one concrete compatibility commitment: the older project-scoped URL form 'will continue to work in perpetuity, but is considered legacy.' The API is also documented through an OpenAPI spec. There is no general deprecation policy or explicit API versioning scheme in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented API versioning scheme, a formal deprecation policy (timelines, notice periods, sunset headers), and independent corroboration of stability in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The previous project-scoped form — `/buckets/{project_id}/...` — remains available and will continue to work in perpetuity, but is considered legacy.
The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
